# Audience research and personas

**Learn who the audience is from analytics, comments, a survey and interviews, then build 2–4 personas and map content to them.**

Finds out who an account's audience really is and what they want — from platform analytics (TikTok Studio, Instagram Insights, YouTube Studio's Audience tab, X, Telegram), comment and DM mining, a short consent-based survey and five interviews — then turns the evidence into 2–4 needs-based personas plus an anti-persona and maps every content pillar and series to them. Use when someone asks "who is our audience", "who are we making this for", before repositioning or a launch, when content is getting views but not follows, when a brand asks for audience data, or when an agent needs a reference for who it writes to. Aggregate data only; never profiles individuals or infers sensitive traits.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |

## How it works

1. Name the decisions it will drive
2. Pull the platform analytics
3. Mine the comments and DMs
4. Run a short survey
5. Talk to five people
6. Cluster into 2–4 personas
7. Map content to personas
8. Test one persona bet
9. Refresh every quarter

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
